About Asmitha Paper Agency

Tiruppur's Trusted B2B Garment & Packaging Paper Supplier

Based in Tiruppur, Asmitha Paper Agency (APA) is a specialized B2B supplier of industrial paper and poly rolls. We provide dependable, wholesale paper and packaging products to garment manufacturing units, export houses, CAD/CAM pattern studios, and packaging businesses across Tamil Nadu.

Our Core Business Focus

We supply exact industrial grades matched to your production floor requirements. Our inventory is dedicated strictly to garment manufacturing, pattern making, and packaging workflows—ensuring reliable stock availability and consistent quality.

What We Supply

  • Garment Cutting Underlay

    100 GSM brown kraft and 80 GSM white underlay papers for clean fabric spreading.

  • Perforated Kraft Lay Paper

    80–100 GSM breathable paper designed for smooth spreading and automated cutting.

  • CAD Plotter Rolls

    60 GSM high-clarity paper for technical markers and pattern plotting.

  • CAD/CAM Duplex Pattern Boards

    Heavy-duty 220 to 400 GSM pattern boards for durable, repeatable apparel templates.

  • Auto-Cutter HM Poly Rolls

    92" to 96" open-width virgin and non-virgin poly rolls for automated spreading floors.
